prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1272; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear passenger door and quarter panel show deformation consistent with a side impact at an intersection, and the crush pattern lines up with the account given of how the collision happened. Parts invoices and shop billing reviewed to date show no repeated or duplicate charges. Labor hours on the estimate run somewhat high for the damage visible, so the shop should be asked to justify the time allotted for panel straightening and refinishing. Nothing in the file suggests earlier damage to this vehicle. Recommended plan: replace the rear door shell, repair the quarter panel, and refinish both panels, subject to a revised labor figure.
